title: Free-sheaf homology of a Cech nerve
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism of presheaves of sets which becomes surjective after sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] (for every object $U$ and $t\in G^\#(U)$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ with each $t|_{U_i}$ in the image of $F^\#(U_i)$), and let $K_n=F\times_G\cdots\times_G F$ with $n+1$ factors and the usual face and degeneracy maps (the $j$-th face omits the $j$-th factor, the $j$-th degeneracy repeats it), a simplicial presheaf [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. For a commutative ring $R$, let $R[K_n]^\#$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf of free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module] $U\mapsto R[K_n(U)]$ on $K_n$. Then the alternating-face complex $\cdots\to R[K_1]^\#\to R[K_0]^\#$, with differential $\sum_j(-1)^jd_j$, has $H_i=0$ for $i>0$, and its augmentation $R[K_0]^\#=R[F]^\#\to R[G]^\#$ induced by $\varphi$ identifies $H_0$ with $R[G]^\#$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), lines 590-660. Proof route: let G' be the presheaf image of F to G. Each fibre of its Cech nerve is the nerve of a nonempty set and contracts after choosing one preimage; the free-R chain complex is homotopy equivalent to the free-R complex on G'. Sheafification is exact for modules and G'^#=G^# by local surjectivity. The free-R variant uses the same simplicial contraction.

proof.text: Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff turns the hypothesis into local surjectivity of the original map. For any set map factor through its image. nerveMonoIso constructs the simplicial isomorphism by inverse wide-pullback lifts. The surjection onto the image has a section by Function.Surjective.hasRightInverse. Arrow.AugmentedCechNerve.extraDegeneracy, mapped by ModuleCat.free R, supplies the contraction; ExtraDegeneracy.homotopyEquiv and HomotopyEquiv.toHomologyIso give vanishing of positive homology. This is proved in type_nerve_positive_exact, including empty sets and the zero ring.

The same extra degeneracy gives s_0 d_1 = id - epsilon s_prime, hence every element of the augmentation kernel is a boundary. The free-module map of the image inclusion is monic by Finsupp.mapDomain_injective, so ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono transfers augmentation exactness along nerveMonoIso to the original target. This is proved in extraDegeneracy_exact and type_augmentation_exact; no sheafified-image comparison is needed.

Kernels, cokernels and homology of module presheaves are sectionwise [lem-weil-pbc-site-r-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact]. The helper nerveMapIso constructs the finite-limit comparison of an evaluated nerve with the nerve of the evaluated map and proves its base and projection formulas. Jointly faithful evaluation detects exactness, by JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.exact_iff; map_alternatingFaceMapComplex commutes evaluation with alternating faces. Therefore presheaf_augmentation_exact and presheaf_nerve_positive_exact establish the presheaf assertions. Exact, additive sheafification from the same cited node preserves both, and commutes with alternating faces by map_alternatingFaceMapComplex.

Prove locally_surjective_hom_ext by separatedness on the covering image sieve. Compose the whiskered ModuleCat.adj R with the sheafification adjunction. Its natural hom equivalence reduces right cancellation for the sheafified free-module map to locally_surjective_hom_ext. The underlying set presheaf of a module sheaf is a sheaf by Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget. The zeroth wide-pullback projection has an explicit section, so its composite with the original locally surjective map is locally surjective. Thus the canonical free-module augmentation is epic, as proved in free_sheaf_map_epi and presheafCechSheaf_augmentation_exact.

The degree-zero formula AlternatingFaceMapComplex.ε_app_f_zero identifies the canonical augmentation's component with the mapped wide-pullback base. Apply quasiIsoAt_iff' and ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros' to the proved exact, epic augmentation, and then quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap. The positive-degree statement follows from presheafCechSheaf_positive_exact and exactAt_iff_isZero_homology. This proves the unchanged statement with no remaining sorry and no project-theorem dependency.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01GC, lines 590-660, R-module variant. T3 implements the image contraction directly using Mathlib extra degeneracies. The categorical comparison and exactness proofs adapt the proved free-abelian implementations in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.Sites.PresheafCechSheafPositiveExact and PresheafCechSheafAugmentationExact to ModuleCat.free R. An adjunction cancellation argument proves epimorphy, replacing the sheafified-image isomorphism step.

split_report.summary: Split following Stacks 01GC (hypercovering.tex 590-660), R-module version. Step 1 replaces G by the presheaf image G' (K is unchanged). Step 2 is the sectionwise computation, Stacks' route through Simplicial 01AB (trivial Kan fibration), 08NS (homotopy equivalence) and 0197 (homology of a constant simplicial object), stated for the free R-module complex of the Cech nerve of a surjection of sets as the new node lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution (unsplit; Mathlib candidate AugmentedCechNerve.extraDegeneracy + ExtraDegeneracy.map + homotopyEquiv; or fibrewise lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible of unit sk-thm-p1, which the item does not cite directly because sk-prop-h2 does not cite sk-thm-p1). Step 3 passes to presheaves (sectionwise homology), step 4 sheafifies (exactness), step 5 replaces R[G']^# by R[G]^#, an identification Stacks leaves implicit (its proof computes Z_{G'} while the lemma states Z_G^#). New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-site-r-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact (Mathlib leaf), lem-weil-pbc-free-module-sheafification-local-iso (Mathlib leaf), lem-weil-pbc-image-presheaf-sheafification-iso (unsplit, Mathlib candidate), lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution (unsplit, Mathlib candidate).
